metadata.title: Harmonicity and Existence of Algebraic Generalized Ricci Solitons
metadata.abstract: In this paper, we study the harmonicity and existence of algebraic generalized Ricci solitons. Firstly, we characterize harmonic torsion of algebraic generalized Ricci solitons on arbitrary metric Lie algebras by an identity involving the Killing form. In particular, positive semidefiniteness of the Killing form implies harmonicity without a unimodularity assumption. Then, we construct generalized nilsolitons with nonzero torsion on indecomposable three-step nilpotent Lie algebras admitting no classical nilsoliton, in dimension seven and in dimensions $6m+d$ for $m>d\geq1$. Furthermore, we provide a spectral obstruction for nilpotent Lie algebras with abelian derived algebra and an obstruction based on the action of derivations on the quotient by the center. Combining these obstructions with explicit constructions, we prove that the filiform Lie algebra $\mathfrak m_2(n)$, $n\geq5$, admits a generalized nilsoliton if and only if $5\leq n\leq8$.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 以 Killing 型恒等式刻画代数广义 Ricci 孤立子的挠率调和性，构造无经典 nilsoliton 的李代数上的广义 nilsoliton，并判定一族 filiform 李代数的存在范围。
techniques: 带挠率的幂零孤立子构造
导子在中心商上的作用
analysis.breakthrough: Killing 型半正定时无需幺模假设即可推出调和性，并给出经典与广义孤立子存在性的分离例子。
analysis.limitations: 结论限于所述代数/左不变框架；m₂(n) 的充要条件为 5≤n≤8，不是所有 filiform 代数的分类。 数学解读仅依据官方摘要与作者评论，尚未审读完整证明。 AI 披露另见独立全文检索与命中核查记录；未检索到声明不代表没有使用 AI。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露通过 OpenAI Codex 使用 GPT-5.6 Sol 与 GPT-6 Astra，协助组织、语言与 LaTeX 编辑、数学核验及部分命题证明；作者称逐项核验了相关证明。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2609.16029v1 · PDF 第3页，Declaration of AI use

analysis.priorityReason: 涉及 Ricci 型几何、明确构造及可复用障碍，值得优先留意，但不是一般 Ricci 流的存在定理。
